name: chamber
description: Checks that the numbers, capitalised names, and file names in a claim occur in the indexed note. Local, no model. It does not judge meaning.

notes.title: Notes folder
notes.description: The folder of notes Chamber checks claims against, such as your Obsidian vault.

exclude.title: Folders to skip
exclude.description: Names or patterns to leave out, such as .obsidian or *sync-conflict*. A name cannot contain a comma.
